segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin generally find the moisturizer lightweight enough not to feel greasy or clog pores, with some saying it sits well on an oily T-zone (35, 41, 49); one calls it best suited to oily rather than dry skin (0).
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: several say it hydrates well and helps flaky, dry patches (10, 39, 73, 76), while others find it too light or watery to be sufficient alone for dry skin, especially without layering (6, 23, 60, 80).
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin mostly report it balances oily and dry areas well and works under makeup (11, 16, 25, 43, 49), though a couple experienced breakouts (2, 7).
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin describe it as gentle, fragrance-free, and non-irritating, including with rosacea and eczema-prone skin (13, 26, 29, 40, 45, 46, 55, 56, 62, 64, 69), but one with non-sensitive skin still broke out badly (3) and it did not fully satisfy one very dry reviewer who needed extra product (60).
segments.normal: Reviewers describing normal skin have mixed reactions, from feeling it just wasn't a good fit (4) to appreciating its lightweight, non-irritating hydration (18).
segments.mature: One reviewer over 40 with dry, rosacea-prone mature skin found it hydrating and non-irritating though slightly sticky (26).

concerns.aging: One mature reviewer with dry, rosacea-prone skin reports good hydration and no irritation (26); no other aging-specific effects are mentioned.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers say it delivers noticeable, lightweight hydration and improves dryness and flakiness (10, 27, 39, 73, 76); a few find it not hydrating enough on its own for very dry skin and need to layer or reapply (6, 23, 60, 80).
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or redness-prone skin report it soothes and calms redness without irritation (26, 29, 47), with no dissenting reports on this specific concern.
concerns.barrier: Some reviewers credit it with improving barrier issues, reduced flakiness, and calming irritated skin (12, 27, 56, 57); one reviewer was unsure it was doing meaningful barrier repair (24).
concerns.spots: One reviewer used it during a fungal acne breakout and reports it did not worsen or clear it but was safe to use (57); no other spot-specific effects are reported.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and some improvement (25, 30, 32, 35, 53, 54, 57, 78), but several report significant new breakouts, especially on cheeks and chin, attributed directly to this product (1, 2, 3, 7).
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report it does not increase oiliness or greasiness and controls shine acceptably (35, 36, 41, 49); no dissent noted on this point.

aspects.libelle: Bottle runs out quickly for price

extraits.texte: I am a huge fan of all my Byoma products, except for this one. I wanted to love this moisturizer, but it broke me out really bad. The first 2 weeks of using it was fine, but after that I noticed I was getting unusual breakouts on my cheeks and chin. This was the only new product in my routine. Once I stopped and went back to my other moisturizer, the breakouts stopped and started healing. No more breakouts since.

I usually don't leave reviews, but this broke me out so bad. I have dry/normal acne prone skin and I loved the feeling of this moisturizer but after 2 days of using it, and it being the only new addition in my routine, I broke out like crazy. I would not recommend for acne prone skin.

I have combination, dehydrated, aging skin, and this is the first moisturizer I've ever used that is ACTUALLY hydrating! It's super lightweight, and plays well with most other products. I've used it under a couple of different mineral sunscreens and it has never made anything get pill-y. It does leave a very slightly tacky finish, but not so much that it's bothersome. I actually think makeup goes on better if I use this with sunscreen on top, rather than this alone. It does not make me break out, amazingly. I'm about to purchase my third bottle…which is where my complaint starts. Like I said, third bottle - in about six months. I use exactly two pumps per day and it's gone SO quickly! Usually a bottle of moisturizer will last me at least 6 months; this one lasts barely two. The bottle is pretty big, but you don't get much product because it's like 80% packaging. If they could reduce the amount of needless plastic I would have no complaints and this would be a five star review.

I really like this moisturizer. I'm 40+ with dry rosacea prone skin and this is scent free and surprisingly good for a light weight moisturizer. I mostly wear it during the day under my makeup since it's a little sticky.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Having rosacea, my skin is really sensitive. BYOMA hydrating milky moisturizer helped soothe my red and angry skin. It was gentle and hydrating. Definitely would encourage anyone else with sensitive skin to check this out!

I have oily acne prone skin and I have a hard time finding a moisturizer that doesn't clog my pores. This moisturizer doesn't make me oily when I wake up in the morning and hasn't clocked my pores at all and I've been using it for about two weeks now.

I tried this moisturizer a bit out of desperation during a fungal acne breakout. I had to use fungal acne-safe skincare on the breakout. It didn't clear the breakout (I didn't exiect it would), but it didn't make it worse like some other moisturizers I tried. It turns out this moisturizer is hydrating but not heavy, is barrier supportive, and also doesn't cause acne. It's become my favorite morning moisturizer and I am impressed at how good the ingredients are, how effective it is, and how affordable. I just really love it - it exceeded my expectations in the best way!
